description: Request body or query parameter is malformed.
troubleshooting: Check the request body against the endpoint reference. JSON parser errors usually indicate trailing commas or unquoted keys.
Add `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header to your request.

description: Token format is invalid or expired.
troubleshooting: Tokens expire in 90 days. Generate a new key in /settings/api-keys.

description: Your key does not include the required scope.
troubleshooting: Edit the key in /settings/api-keys and add the scope listed in `required`.
Verify the resource id. Soft-deleted resources return 404 by default; pass ?include_deleted=1 to include them.
Re-read the resource, merge your changes against the latest version, and retry.
Inspect the `fields` object — each key is a field that failed validation.
Back off for `retry_after` seconds. The default rate limit is 1000 req/minute per key.

description: Something went wrong on our side.
troubleshooting: Include the `request_id` when contacting support. Retry with exponential backoff.
Check /status. We auto-retry transient failures up to 3× before surfacing this.
